name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders & kitchen
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too large a volume of orders and keep selling when the signal disappears. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, and then mark the orders ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T MAKE
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen's pace.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE HATCH
Add orders made on the spot to the same screen as the pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what is being made now, what is next and what is ready, and alerts you when an order needs to be started.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect the kitchen receipt printer by Bluetooth or over the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SELLING WHEN THE SIGNAL DISAPPEARS
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, pre-orders pause so nobody places an order you don't see. Orders you take on the device are kept and synchronised when you are online again.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during the service shift, get a notification when an order is waiting for confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is meant for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
